transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, well, what brought me in is... I keep hearing a man's voice. It usually comes from the vents at the garage where I work, or sometimes right out from under the hood of a vehicle. It's as clear as somebody standing right next to me. He just keeps telling me not to trust my husband, or... telling me not to touch certain cars. I just need to figure out what's going on.
Does the voice ever tell you to do something specific?

Well, mostly just what I mentioned a second ago. He tells me not to trust my husband, or he'll specifically tell me not to touch certain cars in the shop. He doesn't really tell me to go out and do other things, it's more just... telling me who to avoid or what vehicles to stay away from.
Does the voice ever tell you to do something that you feel you must do?

No, I wouldn't say it's like that. It's more of a warning, I guess. He doesn't command me to do anything, he just tells me to stay away from certain things. I don't feel forced, it's just... I usually listen because it makes me nervous not to.
Do you believe what the voice tells you is true?

I mean, I don't know if it's true, exactly. I just... I don't know why he would lie to me. It feels real enough that I don't want to risk ignoring it. Like, what if he's right about the cars, or my husband? I just... I usually just play it safe and listen.
Do you see anything that other people don't?
No, I haven't seen anything like that. It's really just the voice I hear. I don't see things that aren't there.
Do you think the voice might be mistaken about your husband?

I... no, I don't think it's mistaken. I know it sounds really far-fetched, but I’m still convinced my husband and the shop owner where I work have been tracking me. They use the EV chargers and the security cameras to watch exactly what I’m doing. They try to tell me I'm wrong, and they even show me the footage and say there’s nothing there, but... I know what they're doing. So, no, I don't think the voice is wrong about him.
Do you think your husband and the shop owner are really tracking you, even when others tell you there's no evidence of this?

Yes, I do. Like I was just saying, I know it sounds completely far-fetched to anyone else. But I am absolutely convinced they are tracking me. They can pull up the security footage and point at the screen and tell me there's nothing there all they want, but... I know they're using those cameras and the EV chargers at the shop to watch my every move. So, yes, regardless of what they say the evidence shows, I know it's really happening.
Do you ever find it hard to organize your thoughts or express them in a way that feels clear to others?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I feel like I explain things pretty clearly. I know people don't always believe what I'm telling them about what's going on at the shop, but that's not because I can't get my thoughts straight. I don't have any trouble finding the words or making sense when I talk.
Do you feel like your thoughts are connected and make sense when you're talking about the voice and the tracking, or do they feel a bit disjointed?

No, they don't feel disjointed at all. I feel like everything is completely connected. When I'm talking about the cameras or what my husband is doing, it all makes perfect sense to me. I know exactly how the pieces fit together, and I can explain it clearly. It's just... well, like I said, it's just that other people refuse to believe it, not that I'm not making sense when I talk about it.
Do you think your belief about your husband and the shop owner tracking you could be wrong?

No, I don't think I could be wrong. I mean, I know it sounds completely far-fetched, but... I'm still absolutely convinced that my husband and the shop owner have been using the EV chargers and the security cameras to track what I'm doing. Even when they physically show me the footage and tell me there's nothing there, it doesn't change anything for me. I just know it's happening. So, no, I don't believe I'm wrong about this.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are racing or speeding up, making it hard to keep track of what you're thinking?

No, not really. I mean... I don't feel like my thoughts are racing or going too fast. I can keep track of what I'm thinking about just fine. They just kind of move at a normal speed, I guess, so I haven't had any issues with that.
Do you have any other beliefs that you're absolutely certain of, even if others disagree or can't find evidence to support them?

No, not really. I mean, the thing with my husband and the shop owner tracking me is the main thing. I don't have any other big theories or beliefs like that. It's just that one situation that I know is happening, but other than that, no, nothing else comes to mind.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't believe your husband and the shop owner were tracking you?

No, I don't think so. I mean, since this all started, it's just been a constant thing. I haven't had any days or weeks where I suddenly thought, oh, maybe they aren't doing it. It's just always there. I know they are.
Do you think the voice or the beliefs about your husband and the shop owner are strange or hard for others to understand?

I guess I can see why other people might think it's strange. I mean, my husband definitely doesn't agree with me, and he gets frustrated when I bring it up. But to me, it's just... it's just what's happening. It's real. So even if it's hard for someone else to get it, that doesn't change the fact that they're doing it.
Do you think the voice or the messages it gives you are specifically about you or something that applies to everyone?

It's definitely just about me. I mean, the voice... it only talks to me, warning me about what my husband and the shop owner are doing. It doesn't say anything about anyone else or the rest of the world. It's just focused on my situation and what's happening to me.
Have you ever had a time when you didn't believe the voice was real?

No, not really. I mean... I hear it. It's there. It's not like I can just pretend I didn't hear it or tell myself it's not happening. It's as real as you talking to me right now. So, no, I've never thought it wasn't real.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your mood or behavior since the voice started?

Well, yeah, there have been times when my mood was... all over the place. Like, there were these periods where I was barely sleeping at all, just running around the shop with all these huge plans for the business. But even then, when I was feeling so sped up and energized... I was still hearing the voice coming from the air vents. And I was still completely sure about the chargers and the cameras being used to spy on me. So, the mood stuff was happening right alongside the voice and everything else.
Do you think the things the voice says are connected to events or things that happen in your life or to you specifically?

I'm not really sure what you mean by other events. I mean... I haven't noticed it talking about anything else going on in my life, if that's what you're asking. It pretty much just sticks to warning me about the cameras and what my husband and the shop owner are up to. I don't really hear it commenting on... you know, other things that happen to me during the day. It's just focused on the spying.
Do you often find yourself leaping from one idea to another when talking about the voice or the tracking?

I don't think so. I mean... I just say what's happening. I don't feel like my thoughts are jumping around or anything. I'm just trying to explain what the voice tells me about the cameras and the tracking, and I just... tell you what it says. It all makes sense to me, it's not like I'm bouncing from one random thing to another.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt extremely energized or irritable for no reason?

Yeah, I definitely have times like that. Sometimes I'll get so energized, I feel like I'm just... flying high. Like I have enough energy to fix every single car in town all by myself. 

But then, it can turn into this intense anger really fast. Like, if my husband asks why the dishes aren't done, or if one of the other techs at the shop just moves my socket set... I'll completely blow up at them. I just get so mad, like they're trying to hold me down or get in my way.
